# License templates

Templates offered by the "Add a license" selector on the new repository form, one file per
license key (`<key>.txt`). Copied verbatim, without front matter, from the
[choosealicense.com](https://github.com/github/choosealicense.com) catalog vendored by the
`licensee` gem 10.1.0 (MIT). Only `[year]` and `[fullname]` are filled when a repository is
created; every other placeholder stays as is.
